posts.author: okcthunder
posts.summary: OKLAHOMA CITY, Nov. 4, 2026 – The Oklahoma City Thunder has signed guard/forward Dalen Terry to a multi-year contract, it was announced today by Executive Vice President and General Manager Sam Presti. Per team policy, terms of the agreement were not released.
facts: OKLAHOMA CITY, Nov. 4, 2026 – The Oklahoma City Thunder has signed guard/forward Dalen Terry to a multi-year contract, it was announced today by Executive Vice President and General Manager Sam Presti.

Terry (6-6, 210) has appeared in 218 career NBA games (seven starts) in four seasons between the Chicago Bulls and Philadelphia 76ers, and averaged 3.5 points, 1.7 rebounds and 1.2 assists in 11.2 minutes per game.
The Phoenix, Ariz. native was originally selected by the Bulls with the 18th overall pick in the 2022 NBA Draft following two seasons at the University of Arizona.
As a sophomore, Terry helped lead the Wildcats to a 33-4 record and a Pac-12 regular season and tournament championship.
